messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Patients on Tirzepatide 15 mg weekly lost an average of 20.9% or 48.6 lb of body weight.
This occurred after 72 weeks in the Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622).
Placebo patients lost an average of 3.1% or 7.2 lb of body weight.
Study 1 was a 72-week trial.
The trial compared Zepbound weight loss with placebo.
The trial included adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition.
The trial excluded patients with type 2 diabetes.
Zepbound Weight Loss Results at 72 Weeks by Dose:
Treatment dose | Average % weight loss | Average weight lost | Average starting weight
Zepbound 5 mg | 15.0% | 34.0 lb | 226.9 lb
Zepbound 10 mg | 19.5% | 45.5 lb | 233.2 lb
Zepbound 15 mg | 20.9% | 48.6 lb | 232.8 lb
Placebo | 3.1% | 7.2 lb | 231.0 lb
Triplet: ["Zepbound 10 mg", "average starting weight", "233.2 lb"]

The relation 'average starting weight' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject treatment or group had participants with the average initial body weight specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has participant': The study or trial specified by the subject entity includes the group or treatment specified by the object entity as a participant.
B. 'applies to': The subject entity is applicable to the group of patients or conditions specified by the object entity.
C. 'have': The subject group of patients has the medical condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'has usual adult dose': The subject condition or regimen has a standard dose for adults specified by the object entity.
E. 'has weight loss percentage': The subject drug or treatment is associated with the specific percentage of weight loss described by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
